title: Make workflow playbooks role-specific enough to prevent command guessing
description: The current workflow docs are valid but thin and largely share generic steps. In Dabble, agents had to infer conventions such as using issue as a program container, reserving before agent finish, using data.meta.id from work create, and blocking future tasks so only the right work is claimable.
acceptanceCriteria: Work-planning and sprint-launch workflows include exact command sequences for parent issue, sprint, task, dependency, readiness, and closeout flows.
Work-execution workflows state when to use agent finish versus evidence add plus work verify plus work close, including the active-reservation prerequisite.
Workflow tests assert the presence of key command-contract notes that previously caused agent confusion.
closedReason: Generated workflow docs and tests now prevent command guessing for sprint/work execution paths.
